# Tailrocks: Checkout PR Compatibility Alias

`tailrocks-checkout-pr` — part of [tailrocks-skills](../../README.md) · [documentation](https://skills.tailrocks.com/docs/skills/tailrocks-checkout-pr)

Compatibility alias for the deterministic pull-request checkout command. Do not use to create, refresh, review, merge, or otherwise mutate pull requests.

## Invocation

This skill never activates on its own. Name it in your request:

> Use `tailrocks-checkout-pr` …

Arguments: `<PR number | URL | branch> [--confirm-closed <number>]`
